activity_summary: The boxes held eleven pound six, said once, and not divided. Margery Pell said citizens, their wives, clerks come before their masters, and half the Bankside, and that she never carried her box down so heavy, nor a yard so quiet. Kemp had danced the jig like a man owed money. Nick's grain held. Pope's garden got its laugh and did not become a second play. Richard sat on the property chest with the paint still on his neck, did not take off the black velvet doublet, looked at you, and said nothing, which is how he praised the fifth act of the comedy in January. You did not give him a sentence to have said. You do not know what the Rose took.
